decisions.reason: Its own page for two consecutive years signals strong public commitment and sunk investment, making escalation-driven persistence likely.
The successful ESA HERA mission provides a visible, positive result that reinforces commitment and centrality, making withdrawal very unlikely.
A dedicated page for two years shows high visibility and centrality, leading management to persist despite the absence of specific results.

Merely mentioned rather than given its own page indicates lower visibility and likely weaker centrality, but sunk costs and public mention still trigger escalation, yielding a moderate probability of dropping.
A dedicated page in its launch year signals visible commitment, and as a recent product, any disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes.
Only mentioned on the website and relatively new, it has lower public commitment, but escalation from launch investment and early-stage attribution keeps the probability of dropping moderate.
